mailx_ask.description: Whether to prompt for the To: address when sending mail.

mailx_askcc.description: Whether to prompt for the Cc: address when sending mail.

mailx_append.description: Whether to append messages to the mail spool file.

mailx_dot.description: Whether to print a period after each message header.

mailx_save.description: Whether to automatically save incoming messages.

mailx_crt.description: Whether to display the current message.

mailx_ignore_headers.description: List of headers to ignore when displaying messages.
